name: Jietou
source:
This work is adapted from Ding Dongge's novel of the same name.The author is based on the original story of the original line,join a lot of branch plots,the adapted story is very exciting!

In the "isolated island" Shanghai under the Japanese puppet rule, you will play Qin Zheng, the leader of the armed group of the Underground Party. After losing contact with the base area, the armed group will fight in Shanghai alone under the leadership of "you". When you set a trap to lead the enemy to death step by step, another more secret and dangerous trap leads you to a more desperate situation. Can you survive in a difficult choice? Practise deception? Waiting for the final Jedi counterattack? Everything is in your hands.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1109070/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
本作改编自丁东歌的同名小说。作者以原作的主线故事为基础，加入了大量支线情节，让改编后的故事更加精彩！

在日伪统治下的“孤岛”上海，你将扮演地下党武装小组组长秦铮。失去与根据地的联系后，这支武装小队将在你的带领下，孤军奋战于上海。当你们设下圈套，将敌人一步步引向死亡时，另一个更隐秘、更凶险的圈套，却将你们推向更加绝望的境地。在艰难的抉择中，你能否绝处逢生、瞒天过海，等到最后的绝地反击？一切都掌握在你手中。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1109070/]Steam[/url]]
